**$890 — Sharp Arrow Logistics LLC (MC 109876), on load 29000138, Camden NJ → Yonkers NY.**

- The counter came in 2026-05-11: "That rate doesn't work for us. We could do $890" [CE0099]. Our posted rate on that load was $780 for 206 miles, Box Truck [load 29000138] — so they were asking $110 over the posting.
- Runner-up quotes on box truck freight: $865 [CE0162, load 29000614 Harrisburg→Dover], $860 [CE0107, same Camden→Yonkers load], $775 [CE0176, load 29000660 Elizabeth→York].
- Carrier is clean: authority ACTIVE, insurance good to 2027-07-15, reliability 4.5, 7 loads completed [MC 109876]. Note the transcript-style records spell them "Shark Arrow" on calls — the record name is Sharp Arrow Logistics LLC.

Scope of the check: I swept all 36 box-truck rate-counter inquiries (23 emails + 13 undated calls; calls were included and none exceeded $530 [call_004]) and the box-truck rate-question set, which carries no dollar figures. Booking confirmations show agreed rates rather than carrier asks and topped out at $710 [CE0103] in the page I reviewed (58 total, page truncated).
